verdict.rationale: Shopify CLI (shopify-docs-3,17,30,42) and GraphQL Admin/Storefront APIs (shopify-docs-18,31,32) provide command-line and programmatic access that could be scripted, and webhooks (shopify-docs-4,21,43) support event-driven automation, but there is no explicit documentation of running the CLI non-interactively or in a CI pipeline, no CI/CD guide, and no headless-mode flag mentioned.
